findings.title: Render requests can't keep up
findings.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 2/s and can't handle any: its backlog only grows.

findings.title: Poster workers: resource planning
findings.message: At 2/s, up to 60 messages arrive before the 30 s poll, plus 1 s startup. Lower polling interval or raise minimum replicas. This is a configured estimate.

agentReport.simulations: Played 1 saved simulation (at most 60 s each; some stopped there).
